item.title: Electrolyte Solvation Chemistry and Systemic Safety in Potassium‐Ion Batteries
item.description:
این مرور، شیمی حل‌پوشی الکترولیت و ایمنی گرمایی باتری‌های یون پتاسیم را بررسی می‌کند و نشان می‌دهد پایداری فاز میانی و شکاف نیم‌سل به سل کامل موانع اصلی تجاری‌سازی هستند.
Small Structures | ⭐ Review | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This review reframes KIB electrolyte design around solvation chemistry controlling SEI/CEI formation, sorting studies by whether solvation structure was characterized. It reveals a sharp anode divide—solvation-engineered work uses commercial graphite, adopted electrolytes use modified carbons—and shows thermal safety is interfacial, not bulk-solvent, though evidence rests narrowly on potassiated graphite. It identifies half-cell-to-full-cell gaps and interphase-mediated capacity loss as key barriers.
🏷 potassium-ion battery · electrolyte solvation · solid electrolyte interphase · thermal safety · full cell
